answer: Inter-arrival jitter floor.** Each identity’s request timing must match a fitted inter-arrival kernel with minimum entropy: a solo voyage of bursts is fine, but sustained traffic below the jitter floor is throttled. Enforce by sampling arrival gaps and rejecting identities whose gap distribution is too regular. A bot farm can fake randomness, but must maintain per-identity timing state and randomized schedules across a meadow of clones, raising coordination cost per identity.
